ranked.headline: In silico tools rank tumor neoantigens from transcriptomes and immunopeptidomes
ranked.summary: Learned immunogenicity models and immunopeptidomic mapping now score neoantigen candidates directly from sequencing and mass spectrometry data.

ranked.headline: Software tools automate validation and processing of metabolomics and omics data
ranked.summary: Large-scale targeted metabolomics and interoperability gaps between R, Galaxy, and repository formats call for automated, validated processing pipelines.

ranked.headline: Faster estimators for heritability, Y-haplogroups, and fine-scale ancestry inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method pair established population-genetic estimators with faster, deployable implementations.

ranked.headline: Open-source, cloud-based platforms for 3D morphology and spatial biology analysis
ranked.summary: Browser-based cloud desktops, fork-based community curation, and agent benchmarks are now being applied to morphological and spatial biology data.

ranked.headline: LLMs tied to external biomedical references for proteins, pathways, and literature
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test and constrain LLM outputs against protein benchmarks, curated pathways, PubMed retrieval, and GEO dataset metadata.

ranked.headline: Simulation and deep learning resolve protein states and ligand-binding determinants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark free energy methods and pair AlphaFold3 with adaptive sampling to resolve protein states and inhibitor selectivity.

ranked.headline: MD simulations localize residues and regions governing amyloid aggregation propensity
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom and enhanced-sampling MD studies localize aggregation-prone residues in Tau, α-synuclein, Aβ40, and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Microbiome and multi-omics methods are benchmarked and applied to disease outcomes
ranked.summary: Large harmonized microbiome resources and new deep and benchmarked network methods now test host disease associations at scale.

ranked.headline: Learned models integrate spatial, multimodal and single-cell context across omics scales
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell resolution now serve as explicit model inputs, with new foundation models and deconvolution methods scaling to atlas-size data.

ranked.headline: Noise and timing limits constrain gene regulatory and stress-response network behavior
ranked.summary: Quantitative limits on timing precision and noise suppression are now derived for regulatory cascades, stress response, and protein allostery.

ranked.headline: Graph attention models predict drug, protein, and RNA interaction outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply heterogeneous graph attention to interpretable perturbation, binding affinity, and interaction prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Genome and metagenome mining uncovers uncharacterised microbial diversity
ranked.summary: Database-scale resources now pair with tools that compare divergent microbial systems across genomes and metagenomes.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic computational models of tissue-scale transport, signalling and migration
ranked.summary: Recent published models couple explicit tissue-scale transport, signalling and mechanochemical processes to imaging data or organ-level readouts.

ranked.headline: Learning-guided acquisition and classification refine nanoscale imaging readouts
ranked.summary: Learned and computational methods now extract nanoscale structure and biophysical behavior from super-resolution, electron, and neuronal model data.

ranked.headline: Structure-linked modeling and prediction of protein function and interactions
ranked.summary: Genome-scale and metagenome-wide tools now pair structural annotation with ensemble and network-based prediction of protein function and interactions.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes trace lineage-specific gain, loss and innovation across eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Recent mammalian, carnivorous plant and land plant datasets extend comparative analysis of gene and domain evolution across lineages.

ranked.headline: Learned representations adapt to cell imaging and single-cell omics under limited labels
ranked.summary: Label scarcity and cross-modal heterogeneity are driving cell-level models toward self-supervised, semi-supervised, and quality-aware designs.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-aware CRISPR tools link edits and guide efficacy to genotype and expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add haplotype-resolved readouts to CRISPR perturbation and lentiviral vector integration analysis.

ranked.headline: Repeat-aware and learned scoring models reshape sequence alignment and orphan detection
ranked.summary: Two preprints and a published study replace static scoring and fixed alignment models with learned or repeat-aware approaches.

ranked.headline: Physics-based and deep learning methods advance RNA structure and tRNA identification
ranked.summary: Three recent preprints apply probabilistic, linear-time and deep learning models to RNA structure and native tRNA nanopore data.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein stability, phase separation and cryo-EM density
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test what protein language model embeddings and generative models capture beyond a single static structure.

ranked.headline: Frozen predictors and pocket models are repurposed for constrained molecular generation
ranked.summary: Predictive all-atom and affinity models are now being inverted into generators and editors for peptides, pockets, and small molecules.

ranked.headline: Computational antibody design weighed against immunogenicity and developability benchmarks
ranked.summary: Generative antibody design now reports donor-panel immunogenicity, while large benchmarks show developability prediction remains unreliable.

ranked.headline: ML and generative models design antimicrobial peptides and drug-like small molecules
ranked.summary: Recent items pair ML ranking and generative design of antimicrobial peptides and molecules with explainable or property-controlled outputs.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies resolve haplotype variation underlying disease resistance
ranked.summary: Multiple chromosome-scale assemblies, analyzed through graph and k-mer frameworks, now resolve haplotype diversity in candidate resistance genes.

ranked.headline: Faster molecular surface, electrostatics, and property prediction software
ranked.summary: Recent JCIM releases rewrite core structural computation tools for speed, GPU support, and scalability on large biomolecular systems.

ranked.headline: Attention models encode genomic and protein structure for microbial prediction
ranked.summary: Late-2025 preprints apply set, hierarchical, and cross-modal attention to microbial resistance, interaction, and design tasks, pending independent validation.

ranked.headline: Genome co-option and gene-family expansion shape lineage-specific evolution
ranked.summary: Mouse, great ape, and termite genome analyses now show existing elements and gene families being repurposed during divergence.

ranked.headline: Integrating multi-omics and biological networks for cancer and drug prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work fuses omics data, meta-learning and graph networks to predict cancer outcomes, subtypes and drug interactions.

ranked.headline: Language models and foundation models extract microbial traits from text and genomes
ranked.summary: Transformer models now mine bacterial phenotypes from literature at 3.83M-article scale, while genome foundation models target ecophysiological trait…

ranked.headline: Simulated conformational ensembles tested against NMR and chemical probing observables
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair force-field benchmarks and NMR-restrained coarse-grained models with explicit experimental calibration of simulated ensembles.

ranked.headline: Generative and deep learning models design cell-type-specific enhancers tested in vivo
ranked.summary: Designed regulatory sequences are now being paired with functional and in vivo testing, moving generative DNA models beyond in silico prediction.

ranked.headline: Latent factors structure multimodal omics inference for causation, programs, and design
ranked.summary: Expanding modality mixes and perturbation designs in single-cell and multi-omics studies favor factor-structured models for inference.

ranked.headline: Joint sequence-structure optimization and language models guide de novo protein design
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs joint structure-sequence optimization and protein language models with tools for stable sequence design.

ranked.headline: Polymer models link chromatin mechanics and Hox collinearity to epigenetic state
ranked.summary: Recent polymer models tie locus-specific chromatin mechanics and Hox ordering to epigenetic state, extending analysis of 3D contact-map structures.

ranked.headline: Path-integral, graph, and fitness-landscape models of clonal selection dynamics
ranked.summary: Quantitative models of clonal selection now infer treatment optima, drug response contextuality, and karyotype fitness from longitudinal and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Open web and Python tools now target RNA, lipid, and non-canonical amino acid analyses
ranked.summary: Three new open tools address structural analyses of PDB non-canonical residues, RNA ensembles, and lipid nanobubble simulations.

ranked.headline: Learned models score variant pathogenicity and interaction-level consequences
ranked.summary: Preprints now extend variant scoring from single-site pathogenicity to protein interaction and combinatorial burden analyses.
